summary: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited consolidated net revenues for June and Q2 2026. The filing includes revenue figures in NT$ and US$, with sequential and year-over-year comparisons, and breaks down ATM assembly, testing, and material business revenues. It contains forward-looking statements and safe harbor language. This is a routine monthly revenue disclosure under Taiwan regulatory requirements, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved.
